evidence.detail: catches any DatabaseException, not just table-missing errors
MySQL error 1146 (no such table) already raises DatabaseNoSuchTableException specifically
issue text cites (1052, 'Column name in where clause is ambiguous') triggering spurious preaggregation — that's a DatabaseException but NOT a NoSuchTable error, so retry is wrong

triage.fix_sketch: In `shared/decorators.py`: (1) change the import on line 10 to `from shared.pd_exception import DatabaseException, DatabaseNoSuchTableException`; (2) change `except DatabaseException as e:` on line 23 to `except DatabaseNoSuchTableException as e:`. The inner catch on line 28 can remain `DatabaseException` to let non-table-missing errors propagate after the (failed) retry. ~3 lines changed, no schema or data changes.
triage.notes: The DatabaseNoSuchTableException infrastructure is already fully in place; this is purely narrowing the catch. Issue text explicitly names ambiguous-column DatabaseException as the false-trigger case.
